emails.subject: Dispatch logs from the Newark terminal
emails.body:
Dana,

Here are the dispatch logs from the Newark terminal for March through June 2025. Let me know if you need the driver assignments too.

Janet

emails.subject: Imaging timeline
emails.body:
Dana,

We can image the laptop on Thursday once opposing counsel confirms the chain-of-custody protocol. Can you send me the device inventory?

Lena

emails.subject: custodian list
emails.body: Dana, should I add the two dispatch supervisors to the custodian list before it goes out tomorrow? -Tom

emails.subject: Calder 30(b)(6) dates
emails.body:
Dana,

Our designee is available April 14 or April 16. Please let us know which works and whether you will notice it in person.

Grant

emails.subject: Re: Imaging timeline
emails.body:
Lena,

Thursday works. I'll send the device inventory today and confirm the protocol with opposing counsel.

Dana

emails.subject: Preliminary imaging report
emails.body:
Dana,

Attached is our preliminary report. Short version: three USB transfers in the week before her resignation.

Lena

emails.subject: Re: Calder 30(b)(6) dates
emails.body:
Grant,

April 16 works for us. We will serve an amended notice this week and plan to proceed in person at your offices.

Dana

emails.subject: Re: custodian list
emails.body: Yes, add both and flag the warehouse manager as well. Thanks.

emails.subject: Ostrander - opposition to PI motion
emails.body:
Counsel,

Attached is Dr. Ostrander's opposition to the motion for preliminary injunction, filed this morning, with her supporting declaration.

Evan Kessler
Gray Kessler LLP

emails.subject: Ruiz payroll and timekeeping records
emails.body:
Dana,

Attached are Carlos Ruiz's payroll and timekeeping records for 2024 and 2025.

Derek

emails.subject: Supplemental declaration for your review
emails.body:
Lauren,

Attached is a draft supplemental declaration describing the server access logs. Please confirm paragraphs 4-9 match what your IT team found.

Dana
